meta.title: CSV Import Feature - How the Session Moved

nodes.label: Import CSV?
nodes.explanation:
The user asked for a CSV upload so shop staff can import orders in bulk instead of typing them.

Known at this point: files come from a spreadsheet export, up to about 200k rows; the orders table already has validation in the API layer.

Nothing was decided yet about sync vs background processing.

nodes.label: Validate first
nodes.explanation:
User call: show row-level errors before anything is written, so staff can fix the sheet and retry.

Why: a half-imported file was the main complaint with the old tool.

Rejected: 'import what you can and report the rest' — harder to undo.

nodes.label: Parse in memory
nodes.explanation:
First approach: load the whole file with pandas and validate with the existing schema.

Worked on the 1k-row sample in 0.4 s.

nodes.label: OOM at 200k
nodes.explanation:
The 200k-row test file killed the worker (memory limit 2 GB; peak 1.9 GB before the kill).

Cause: whole-file DataFrame plus a copy per validation pass.

This is the turn that changed the design.

nodes.label: Stream rows
nodes.explanation:
User call after the OOM: stream the file in 5k-row chunks and run the job in the background.

Trade-off accepted: the error report now arrives by notification, not inline.

nodes.label: Chunked import
nodes.explanation:
Rewrote the import as a generator over csv.DictReader with 5k-row chunks.

200k rows: peak 180 MB, 38 s end to end. Row errors collected to a CSV the user can download.

nodes.label: Review session
nodes.explanation:
A separate review session read the diff and found two issues: BOM at the start of Excel exports broke the header match, and a chunk boundary could split a duplicate check.

Both fixed here with tests.

nodes.label: Merge?
nodes.explanation:
Open: the PR is ready and tests pass. Waiting for the user to decide whether to ship behind a feature flag first.

Not done: load test on production-size data (only the 200k test file was used).

cards.title: Drill path
items: Ship: waiting on a flag decision
